limits: One real run per control, not model performance or a success-rate estimate.
Blocked client verifies visible undiggable bedrock and approaches it; it does not attempt to dig the enclosed log or establish arbitrary-agent impossibility.
The enclosed-target control verifies six adjacent bedrock faces; arena boundary readbacks still sample points.
Injected-item, interrupted-action and observation-failure cases for this oak task remain open.
Setup commands construct and normalize the fixture before action; they are not agent-earned achievements.
Pure endpoint scorer always reports gameplayQualified false; outer launcher separately validates lifecycle, provenance, resources and storage.
